title: Multi-layout DWG writer source-confirmed capability gap
mode: Deeper/broader primary-source research and implementation-plan update

localScope.head: de27a33
localScope.worktreeState: The writer/test sources inspected are substantially modified and uncommitted; observations describe the current worktree, not a clean origin/master checkout.
sourcesInspected: src/intern/dwgwriter15.cpp: defineBlock(DRW_Block_Record), emitBlockRecord, emitDeferredBlockControl, prepareBlockOwnedEntity, recordBlockOwnedEntity, encodeEntity
localScope.evidence: The current worktree rejects DRW_Block_Record values with nonzero layoutHandle, emits a null BLOCK_RECORD layout-handle slot, and defers only the fixed *Model_Space and first *Paper_Space owners. Existing tests cover DXF Paper_Space0 as a block body and selected standalone LAYOUT fields, not a closed multi-layout DWG ownership graph.
localScope.classification: Source-confirmed capability gap; writer refuses the unrepresented association, so this is not classified as silently corrupted output.

sources.project: Open Design Alliance DWG specification v5.4.1
sources.observation: The specification distinguishes versioned entity owner/mode representations, fixed Model/Paper roots and other BLOCK_CONTROL entries, and a hard-pointer Layout Handle in the BLOCK_HEADER/BLOCK_RECORD form.
sources.planDisposition: Use as authoritative byte-layout contract. Keep R13-R14 chain/mode behavior separate from R2004+ owned-object lists and validate every changed target version.

sources.observation: The published contracts identify BLOCK_RECORD as layout entity owner, document predefined Model/Paper/Paper_Space0 records, define BLOCK_RECORD group 340 as a hard pointer to its LAYOUT, and describe LAYOUT properties/links separately.
sources.planDisposition: Require independent identities for layout, block record, owner, active/current role, and entity placement; do not infer them from suffix or PaperSpace boolean alone.

sources.observation: CADCraft #1463 remains an open report of non-active layout entities appearing on the first sheet in ZWCAD 2025 despite same-codec membership readback; PR #1080 changes the app-side non-active owner/mode path. ACadRust #143 is closed as completed and reports duplicate bare *Paper_Space names after suffix stripping. Current pinned ACadRust source documents a helper that reserves the bare name for the active record while avoiding collisions; issue body warns raw suffix preservation alone did not establish a correct active record.
sources.planDisposition: Use as distinct failure shapes and a future pinned comparison route, not as normative format authority, local reproduction, or support proof. Verify ownership/mode by ODA and exact target version.

sources.observation: The manual documents distinct ModelSpace, PaperSpace, and Blocks containers and BLOCK_CONTROL/BLOCK_HEADER access, but the reviewed material is not a version-specific multi-layout writer acceptance result.
sources.planDisposition: Optional exact-pinned independent structural reopen at the composed checkpoint only; no peer executable was run.

assessment.newFinding: PAR-144: multi-layout DWG writer does not currently represent/emit reciprocal LAYOUT to BLOCK_RECORD ownership in the inspected worktree
assessment.existingOwner: 7G.3 layout graph / DWG writer owner ledger

implementationReadiness.fastTestOwner: Extend existing DWG local roundtrip tests with from-scratch generated in-memory multi-layout cases; no external or persistent fixture and no new CTest target.
acceptance: Reciprocal one-to-one LAYOUT/BLOCK_RECORD identity and correct dictionary reachability
Unique active/default and inactive paper-space owner names without suffix-only identity inference
Exact entity, viewport, INSERT, ATTRIB/SEQEND and owner-membership disposition per layout
Atomic refusal, preexisting-destination preservation, and corrected same-writer retry
Independent pinned structural reopen and separate native-application qualification only at composed checkpoint
implementationReadiness.progressPolicy: Update the plan/receipt after each implemented item, report progress and commit identity after each committed slice, and self-unblock past unavailable external/native gates.

limitations: The local audit was performed on a heavily modified uncommitted worktree, not origin/master or a clean checkout. No parser/production change, test, peer executable, or native application was run. CADCraft/ACadRust issue reports and source are project evidence, not independent native acceptance or format authority.
